_README: Feeds the indicative range in block B2 of /property-valuation-dubai/.
This file is EMPTY on purpose. The tool needs a price-per-square-foot band per
community and property type, and 03-PAGE-SPECS/01 marks this page's research depth as
'HIGH - needs live DLD transaction comparables per community'. No such dataset ships
in Dubai Marina transacted between AED 1.1M and 1.9M in Q2 2026') and forbids anything
naming a specific unit. Fill this with aggregates from Dubai Land Department
transaction data and the tool stays on the allowed side of that line.
While `communities` is empty the tool renders a stated-gap notice instead of a number,
and scripts/gate.mjs fails the production build.
psfLow/psfHigh are AED per square foot, from transactions in the stated window.
